title: Consolidate the verified Scroll v17 candidate baseline
mission: Consolidate archaeology, deterministic Chromium interaction evidence, and served-endpoint CI evidence into one exact candidate-baseline manifest for Scroll v17. Identify the strongest evidence-backed baseline without inventing Human Acceptance/champion authority and make rollback/test refs explicit for future work.
definition_of_done: Manifest records exact main, gh-pages and served identities with provenance.
Desktop/mobile geometry and served-CI receipts are linked and summarized without overstating Human Acceptance.
Known branch-byte divergence is either resolved by its sibling job or explicitly represented as a non-behavioral debt.
Future Scroll mutations have one pinned baseline, rollback donor and regression command/workflow reference.
Human Acceptance/champion remains UNPROVEN unless an explicit durable human receipt exists.
